title: Claude Code Can Now Control Your Computer

slides.text:
Anthropic just shipped <accent>Computer Use</accent> for Claude Code.

It can now natively control your mouse, keyboard, and take screenshots to interact with any app on your desktop.

Here's what it does, how to set it up, and the best use cases.

slides.heading: The <accent>Announcement</accent>
slides.caption: Anthropic's official post - Computer Use is live in Claude Cowork and Claude Code

slides.heading: Enable It in <accent>Settings</accent>
slides.caption: Claude Desktop App → Settings → General → Toggle Computer Use ON

slides.heading: How It <accent>Works</accent>
slides.body:
Claude takes a screenshot of your screen
Identifies UI elements and buttons
Clicks, types, and navigates for you
Asks for confirmation on sensitive actions

terminal.text: > Find the ROI calculator PDF in my downloads and send it via ClickUp DM

slides.heading: The <accent>Dispatch</accent> Combo
before: You can't remote into your laptop
Task sits waiting until you're back
after: Finds the file and sends it

slides.heading: The <accent>Workflow</accent>
elements: You send a message from phone

slides.heading: What It Can <accent>Do</accent>
items: Screenshot Capture - see your screen in real time
Mouse Control - click, drag, scroll, move cursor
Keyboard Input - type text and use shortcuts
Desktop Automation - interact with any app

slides.heading: The <accent>Agent Loop</accent>
slides.body:
- Claude sees your screen via screenshots
- Decides which tool action to take next
- Executes: mouse click, keyboard, or bash
- Checks the result via new screenshot
- Loops until the task is complete
- Asks for confirmation on risky actions

slides.heading: Best <accent>Use Cases</accent>
items: Send files via Slack, Telegram, or any app
Run calculations and save to Notes
Automate legacy apps with no API
Test your apps - find bugs automatically

slides.heading: Current <accent>Limitations</accent>
slides.body:
- Research preview (Mac OS only, Windows coming soon)
- Can't click inside browsers (security restriction)
- Workaround: Chrome extension or Playwright CLI
- Pro and Max plans only (not Teams/Enterprise)
- No drag, zoom, or fast notification handling yet

slides.heading: Who Gets <accent>Access</accent>
slides.body:
- Available in Claude Desktop App (Mac OS)
- Works in both Cowork and Claude Code
- Requires Pro or Max subscription
- Windows support coming in weeks
- Teams and Enterprise plans coming later

slides.text: It's pretty much going to be as if you have a real human working on your laptop.

slides.heading: The <accent>Big Picture</accent>
slides.body:
- Anthropic ships a new feature almost every day
- Moving toward full native desktop control
- Browser automation coming next
- Scheduled tasks + Computer Use = AI employee
- Connectors first, Computer Use as fallback
